name: domain-experts
description: Toolkit for building, evaluating, evolving, and contributing domain expert agents in Claude Code. Four skills (domain-creator, domain-eval, domain-capture, domain-contribute) plus Nala — a venture-building reference agent built using the toolkit. v0.3 adds domain-contribute (with PATCH and PUBLISH modes — improve installed agents OR ship brand-new ones to the catalog without leaving the venture's project).
